Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: 14-window-rain.png, ultra-wide exterior backdrop plate for a Blender window, not an interior photograph.
Primary request: the unobstructed OUTSIDE VIEW from the Cuddlecore country inn kitchen. Reference image 1 is ONLY a visual reference for the coast visible beyond its window and photographic realism; DO NOT include any interior or window. Reference image 2 is ONLY a geography/landscape reference: fictional quiet coastal countryside with green fields, hedgerows, sheltered curving bays and soft coastal headlands. Render the landscape as a real photograph, never a watercolor.
Scene: rainy late afternoon on a quiet English/Kiwi coast. Foreground is a wet cottage garden gently sloping away from ground-floor viewpoint, with a low old gray stone wall running across the lower portion, rosemary and long grass. Middle distance green patchwork fields and hedgerows descend toward a sheltered bay. Beyond is gray-blue sea, distant low headlands fading into rainy mist. Terrain is soft and grounded, not dramatic mountains. Rain in the AIR only, fine light atmospheric rain, never giant foreground drops. Low overcast gray cloud shows subtle shape and layered detail without a blown-white sky. Natural muted greens, wet stone, quiet gray-blue sea, soft even cool light, gentle contrast. No sunset or warm artificial light.
Composition: ONE very wide 3:1 panoramic landscape image, ideally 3072 by 1024 or the widest landscape output available, at least 21:9. Preserve generous side coverage for viewing from different angles in 3D. Eye height 1.6m at a ground-floor window, looking straight out, level horizon 45% UP FROM BOTTOM / 55% DOWN FROM TOP. Natural 35mm photographic perspective with extended horizontal coverage, no fisheye, no tilted verticals or aerial viewpoint, everything sharp. Clear stable identifiable stone-wall contour, fields, shoreline and headlands so the exact image can be edited into weather variants later. This rainy image is the definitive locked camera and terrain master.
CRITICAL EXCLUSIONS: NO window, no window frame, no mullions, no glass, no rain drops/streaks on glass, no lens rain, no curtains, no sill, no room, no reflection, no foreground vignette/arch/frame, no text, signs, labels, logos, watermark, people, animals, cars, boats or modern structures. No panels, montage or borders. Photographic realism and natural imperfections, not CGI or illustration.

For a 2172x724 canvas the sea horizon should sit around y=398px. Lower the terrain and sea in composition while retaining the foreground garden wall visible at the lower edge, natural 1.6m standing ground-floor viewpoint. This will be the definitive camera master, so prioritize deliberate stable composition. Soft overcast cloud with gray detail occupies upper half, not white sky, no sun. Everything sharp natural 35mm extended coverage, no wide-angle distortion.
No window, frame, room, curtain, glass, lens droplets, rain on glass, people, animals, cars, text, signs, logos or watermark. Rain only in air, no bright colors. ONE image ultra-wide 3:1.
